configureMiningSystem(address).details: Call path: Deploy._configure -> MiningEarningsSettlement.configureMiningSystem; then MiningSystem.withdrawImmediate/withdrawNormal/consumeComposition -> this contract.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

settleComposition(address,uint256,uint25.details: Enforces the validation, accounting, and state-transition rules required by settleComposition. Additional validation, accounting, and bounded-execution rules apply. Call path: CardComposer.composeCard -> MiningSystem.consumeComposition -> MiningEarningsSettlement.settleComposition -> PriceOracle/RewardDistributor/MiningSystem/NodeRewardPool.

settleWithdrawal(address,uint256,uint256.details: Enforces the validation, accounting, and state-transition rules required by settleWithdrawal. Additional validation, accounting, and bounded-execution rules apply. Call path: MiningSystem.withdrawImmediate/withdrawNormal -> MiningEarningsSettlement.settleWithdrawal -> PriceOracle.quoteUsdtToMobSpot -> RewardDistributor.recordWithdrawalRewards -> MiningSystem.consumeDynamicExitCapacity -> NodeRewardPool.recordNetworkReward -> InteractionPool.pay.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

configureTradingRouter(address).notice: Configures the TradingRouter that records MÖB actually paid to users.
